description: Generates product embeddings during bulk indexing using a locally hosted ONNX model. Running embedding generation inside the ingest pipeline rather than as a separate pass means OpenSearch never receives a document without its vector, so the index is never partially searchable on the semantic path. The model runs in-cluster, so no API key and no per-token cost.

remove.description: The concatenated text exists only to feed the model. Dropping it keeps the stored document lean, since canonical_title and description are already indexed separately.
